story.wayReveal: Sufi knowledge is the spirit of our religion and its highest degree. The path is clear — smoothed by the Beloved ﷺ, who gathered it into a single sentence.
story.wayHadith: Worship God as though you see Him.
story.wayMaxim: Belittle yourself, and give importance to your neighbor.
story.wayMaximGloss: All the teachings, summarized in one line.
story.shaykhPoem1: Is it myself or my shadow that you see?
story.shaykhPoem2: This can be grasped only by him who has become like me.
story.shaykhLine: Shaykh Mohamed Faouzi al-Karkari — of noble Prophetic descent, Idrisi and Hasani. At nineteen, he left everything he had, and walked.
story.wanderQuote1: I took the earth as my bed, and the starry sky as my blanket.
story.wanderQuote2: I travelled across the mountains, but I entrusted my luggage with God.
story.wanderQuote3: Whenever I would supplicate God, He would respond to my supplication.
story.khalwaLead: Then, in a dark room of his uncle's zāwiya — the khalwa — his repentance was answered.
story.khalwaGloss: He saw it written before him, in letters of light.
story.silsilaLead: Hand to hand, heart to heart — the permission of this path descends through a chain of masters, reaching back to the Messenger of God ﷺ.
story.nurLead: The path is the seeking of that light — until it is seen, not as a metaphor, but with the eye.
story.nurHadith: O Jābir, the first thing God created was the light of your Prophet, from His light.
story.nurLink: Start here: the vision of light
story.wayMercy: In our way we never belittle anyone who bears witness to God's oneness — the Truth placed in our hearts a mercy for all His creation, even the smallest ant.
story.wayHidden: This knowledge comes from Him, and we do not hide it. We withhold it only from those who make sport of Him; to every sincere seeker, the door is open.
story.shaykhReturn: When he returned, he burned all he owned, borrowed a brother's garment, and walked barefoot in tears to his shaykh at Temsemen.

shaykhDates.label: Born in the Rif, into a house of remembrance
At nineteen, he leaves everything — ten years of wandering
The khalwa — the Greatest Opening, the hidden Name
After his shaykh's passing, the Seal — the mashyakha

story.nurDoor: Walk toward God through the door of the Messenger ﷺ — and whoever refuses will remain veiled, excluded from the path.
story.nurWhat: The Nūr Muḥammadī is the luminous reality behind the visible form of the Prophet ﷺ — the first thing God created, taken from His own light.
story.nurSeen: It is seen with the eye, not as metaphor — and reached only in the company of those who carry it: the people of light.
story.mishkatLead: The proof is not scarce — it fills the Book, the ḥadīth, and the words of the knowers. Turn through it.
story.nurCouplet1: A spirit of light in a body like the moon,
story.nurCouplet2: a mantle embroidered with brilliant stars.
story.nurCoupletSource: Ḥassān ibn Thābit — of the Messenger ﷺ
story.foundationsLead: By the grace of God, our way is clear and simple.

quran.text: God is the Light of the heavens and the earth.
And he to whom God has not granted light — for him there is no light.
God brings the believers out from the darknesses into the light.
There has come to you from God a light and a clear Book.
So believe in God and His Messenger, and the Light which We have sent down.

hadith.text: O God, place light in my heart, and light in my tongue; light in my hearing, and light in my sight… and make me light.
The first thing God created was the light of your Prophet, from His own light.
Fear the perception of the believer, for he sees with the light of God.
God created His creation in darkness, then cast His light upon them; whoever it touched was guided.
His veil is light; were He to lift it, the glories of His Face would burn all creation His sight reaches.

khabar.text: Knowledge is a light God places in the heart.
When the attributes of darkness lift, light takes their place — and the one with the eye of the soul sees.
Sufism is a lightning that burns everything.
The knowers are the lamps of their age; by them the people are guided.
God created the Muhammadan Light so that intellects, hearts and souls would be illumined.
